text:
are you married? if not, you need to do the partner visa route, otherwise you can make aliyah with your partner. usually for the partner visa a lawyer is not needed, unless you have a complicated case, you can read more here: https://aic.org.il/do-i-need-a-lawyer-to-successfully-get-a-partner-visa/
regarding work: it doesnt make sense to apply for jobs yet, as it can take several months til up to a year to get a visa. but you can already update your linked in profile and make connections for your job. it might be easier to make connections once you are in israel. search for groups in social media/linkedin, some professions have also meetups etc.
